scope: Scoped election and effective vacancy facts only; no whole-roster, boundary or statistical refresh.

facts.finding: Jordyn Princi elected unopposed on 28 October 2026 at 10am AEDT. No voting is required; the December polling timetable is superseded.
Nominations closed 28 October 2026 at noon AEDT. The published poll remains 28 November; no final ballot or uncontested result inferred.
Paul Amos resigned effective 14 October 2026; one councillor vacancy proceeds to the confirmed 12 December by-election.
Simon Robinson resigned effective immediately in the official 9 October 2026 notice. Council awaits WAEC advice whether an extraordinary election is required and its date. No election assumed.
Cr Johnston resigned in August 2026; the official notice does not establish an exact effective day. Town Ward postal extraordinary election remains 3 December 2026.
Postal voting closed 27 October 2026 at 2pm AEDT. Counting began 28 October at 9am AEDT. Results are progressive; this review does not certify individual contests or replace current-office rosters.
